title: Beef Stew with Venezuelan Twist
description: A hearty beef stew with a unique Venezuelan flavor, inspired by Chinese cuisine.
instructions: 1. Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
2. Add beef cubes and brown on all sides, about 5 minutes. Remove beef from pot and set aside.
3. Add remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil to pot and sauté diced onion and minced garlic until softened, about 5 minutes.
4. Add diced red bell pepper and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
5. Add tomato paste and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
6. Add beef broth and bring to a boil.
7. Return beef cubes to pot and bring to a simmer.
8. Reduce heat to low and cook, covered, until beef is tender, about 2 hours.
9. Stir in diced tomatoes and chopped Venezuelan cilantro.
10. Serve hot, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
